notes.title: Outskirts is now released!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26604515/494fa24a6c11344a97387425c69fe0ea38c3df62.jpg[/img]

[h1]It was about time![/h1]
Today is a great day, Outskirts is finally released!

[b]So what exactly is Outskirts? Glad you asked:[/b]
[list]
    [*]Circular battlefield.
    [*]Play with the depth of the map to manage waves of enemies.
    [*]A colour system to absorb enemy bullets and optimize your damages.
    [*]Deep and rewarding combo system.
    [*]No randomness.
    [*]Interactive music.
    [*]Addictive (very)..
    [*]Easy to play, hard to master.
[/list]

The fabulous and dazzling OST is available on [url=https://valentinducloux.bandcamp.com/album/outskirts]Bandcamp.[/url]

We hope you’ll enjoy the game and we can't wait to see your highscores!
